name: iBabs Besluit to decidesk Decision
description: Maps an iBabs besluit (RIS decision on a motion) onto decidesk's unified Decision schema with decisionType=motion (Motion/Amendment/Resolution were folded into Decision in the decision-model refactor). besluitStatus aangenomen/verworpen maps to outcome adopted/rejected. lifecycle is set to decided since besluiten are final.

mapping.title: {{ values.titel ?? values.onderwerp ?? values.naam }}
mapping.outcome: {% set s = (values.besluitStatus ?? values.status ?? '')|lower %}{% if s == 'aangenomen' or s == 'aangenomen met algemene stemmen' %}adopted{% elseif s == 'verworpen' %}rejected{% else %}{% endif %}
